name: Open Prospector
description: Lead sourcing and enrichment on your own provider keys. The agent researches the live web to find companies and people matching an ICP; the app resolves emails and phones through a configurable provider waterfall with a cache and a per-credit cost ledger. Pays vendors at cost with no per-lead markup. Deliberately has no email-sending capability. An open-source alternative to Clay and per-lead AI prospecting tools.
